claims.summary: Timberlake describes Russian adjectives in predicative position and notes that the long form can serve as a predicate, including in constructions with past/future быть; the entry is restricted to this syntactic fact and removes an unsupported example-based rule.

locator.label: §§ 5.2.5–5.2.6, p. 282, lines 10344–10363: qualitative adjectives can function as predicates; long-form adjective may occur predicatively, including with past/future быть.
